entities.summary: Chloe Jackson is an American professional basketball player who is a free agent. She most recently played for the Chicago Sky of the Women's National Basketball Association. She was drafted by the Sky with the 15th overall pick of the 2019 WNBA draft after playing a successful college basketball career for the Baylor Lady Bears of the Big 12 Conference. She was waived by the Sky in August 2019.
